paper_title: Axion search with quantum nondemolition detection of magnons
notes: Axion-electron coupling search via QND magnon detection. Upper limit g_aee < 2.6e-6 at 95% CL for mass range 33.117-33.130 ueV, assuming local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and vtot=220 km/s. A more conservative angle-averaged result gives g_aee < 1.6e-7 (Appendix A), but the headline result quoted in abstract/conclusion is 2.6e-6.
